description: R5, R6: wait prints the script's own clock and each unfinished label's age in minutes, with a script-computed status: `stalled` only when the child has no final message and its last record is more than 10 minutes before now (strictly: exactly 10.0 is still running; 9.5 running; 10.2 and 45.0 stalled; 4.0 running), so the 10-minute rule never depends on the caller's clock. A label with a final message carries no age or status, however old its records. A label still missing is a failed child, said plainly in its line and on a `missing:` line.
